howItWorks.title: From request to court in 4 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: No online payments, no surprises. We handle every booking personally.

1.title: Send your request
1.text: Choose format, pack, date and extras in the booking builder, or message us on WhatsApp.

2.title: We call or message you
2.text: Within 24 h we confirm availability, level and any details.

3.title: Confirm with a deposit
3.text: We send you the payment details. Once the deposit is paid, the place is yours.

4.title: Come and play
4.text: A few days before, you get your stay guide: schedule, what to bring and how to get here.

howItWorks.cancellationNote: ⚠️ Provisional terms: review them before publishing.

cancellation.1: Cancel more than 30 days ahead: full deposit refund.
cancellation.2: Between 30 and 15 days: 50 % refund or free date change.
cancellation.3: Less than 15 days: no refund, but you can transfer your place to someone else.
cancellation.4: If we cancel (extreme weather, force majeure), you get a full refund.

academy.title: We give padel a system
academy.history1: Padel System Academy was born from the idea of combining two things that usually stay apart: quality coaching and the experience of travelling to play. After years coaching players of every level, we saw that the ones who improved most were those who could concentrate training hours with rest and follow-up.
academy.history2: So we created a closed, all-inclusive format: you arrive, and we take care of the courts, accommodation, meals and, above all, a training plan that makes sense.

1.title: Precision
1.text: Every drill has a purpose. No random balls.

2.title: Speed
2.text: Small groups to maximise every player's time on the ball.

3.title: Energy
3.text: Demanding and fun at the same time. We work hard and enjoy it.

4.title: Honesty
4.text: We tell you where you are and what you need, even if it's not what you want to hear.
